name: Reflexio
description: Cross-session memory via Reflexio: injects relevant preferences and skills before each turn and publishes completed turns for extraction.

url.description: Reflexio API base URL. Defaults to REFLEXIO_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8061/.

apiKey.description: Bearer token for managed or self-hosted Reflexio. Defaults to REFLEXIO_API_KEY. Prefer a secret reference such as "${REFLEXIO_API_KEY}".

min_prompt_length.description: Minimum trimmed prompt length before retrieval; zero admits every nonempty prompt.

timeout_ms.description: Search deadline in milliseconds; the hook reserves an additional second for host overhead.

max_content_length.description: Maximum redacted characters retained per published message; a truncation marker may follow. Full reply text is retained locally for citation resolution.
